outcome: Number of caesarean sections per Robson group
cohort: The study included 1000 cases of women delivering at PDU medical college and hospital Rajkot, Gujarat.
finding: The overall prevalence rate of Caesarean section was 27.4%, with women having one or more previous caesareans (Robson Group V) contributing the maximum number of C-sections (39.78%).
mod_finding: Women with one or more previous caesareans (group V) had the maximum number of caesarean sections (39.78%), closely followed by nulliparous women with spontaneous onset of labour at >37 weeks (group I) and nulliparous women >37 weeks who were induced (group IIA).
gest_age: Included women with gestational age >37 weeks as part of Robson's classification.
